javac.notes: unchanged; class files are version 71 (Java 27); javac's default debug info (source, lines) has no effect on JIT-compiled code

build_steps.why: classes pre-loaded and linked plus method profiles of a training run (synthetic data, generic queries, driven through the real session entry point); used by the launcher with -XX:AOTCache when newer than the jar, ignored silently when unusable; the build succeeds without it if training fails

jvm_flags.why: same latency as the default G1 at about 1.5 GB less peak RSS on the 1m workload
hot query code reaches C1/C2 sooner: first executions about 20-25 % faster, start-up and RSS unchanged
AOT cache (see build_steps); JVM logging off because stdout carries the protocol

code: sort: order-preserving 64-bit keys per sort column (plus a second string prefix and the length) compared in one loop, no per-comparison dispatch on the column kind
INT64/DECIMAL/FLOAT64 arithmetic: one small kernel class per operator instead of a switch on the operator per element
column statistics: typed loops over the chunks' primitive arrays and a primitive exact distinct set instead of boxing every value into a HashSet
string comparison with a constant over small dictionaries: evaluated once per dictionary entry, rows map their codes
object interning (group keys, DISTINCT aggregates, dictionary encoding): primitive open-addressing table instead of HashMap<Object, Integer>
dropped: jlink runtime image with java.base only (start-up not measurably faster; only -2.7 MB idle RSS)
G1 (default), ZGC, Serial GC (no latency gain; more RSS, or slower loading)
hoisting the operator switch out of the arithmetic loops within one class (C2 already unswitches it: no measurable effect)
plain instanceof instead of pattern switches at the call sites the parallel workers link concurrently (cold -5 %, within noise)
tuning.launcher: bin/polyquery locates the engine from $0 without starting processes (no dirname/readlink/cd subshell unless the launcher is a symlink)

compiler.aot: every namespace AOT-compiled (script/compile.clj); verified: no namespace compiled or loaded from source at run time (-Xlog:class+load)
compiler.lint: make lint compiles with *warn-on-reflection* and *unchecked-math* :warn-on-boxed and fails on any reflection, boxed-math or performance warning

build.jar: target/polyquery.jar (the JDK AOT cache only covers classes loaded from jar files)
build.aot_cache: make build records target/polyquery.aot with -XX:AOTCacheOutput by replaying a synthetic training session (script/training.clj: generated tables with NULLs in every column type, generic queries, never the benchmark queries) through bin/polyquery; training failure leaves no cache and the build still succeeds

launcher_jvm_flags: -XX:AOTCache=target/polyquery.aot (only when the file exists; -Xlog:aot*=off,cds*=off so a stale or unusable cache is ignored silently)
-XX:+UseParallelGC (kept from the accepted engine; G1 and Serial measured, not better)
code: boxed arithmetic removed from every namespace (primitive locals, ^:const constants)
sort: one comparator type switching on key kind (no megamorphic per-key calls, no boxing), 8-byte UTF-8 prefixes for string keys, merge-path parallel merges, parallel key extraction
positions-where is a macro (no boxed predicate call per row); no not= on primitives in hot loops
MIN/MAX states and comparators branch on the sign instead of a checked multiplication
rejected: Math/addExact|subtractExact|multiplyExact in arithmetic kernels (existing explicit overflow checks kept)
